HTTP header checker

Enter a URL to see its status code and headers, and check for a noindex header.

What this checks

Fetches the URL and shows the status code, the X-Robots-Tag header and five common security headers.

How to fix common problems

  • Make sure important pages return status 200.
  • Remove any X-Robots-Tag noindex from pages that should rank.
  • Add HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options for basic protection.

Common questions

What does X-Robots-Tag do?

It sends indexing instructions in the HTTP header, such as noindex, instead of in the page HTML.

Are security headers a ranking factor?

Not directly, but they protect visitors and show a well-maintained site.
